concept.name: Calibration
concept.definition: Agreement between forecast probabilities and observed event frequencies, such that events assigned probability p occur about proportion p in comparable cases.
concept.intuition: It summarizes one aspect of prediction error or decision quality in a number or curve.
concept.mechanics: Bin or smooth held-out forecasts, compare mean predicted probability with empirical frequency, and assess with reliability plots and proper scoring rules.
concept.failure_modes: Class imbalance, threshold choice, unequal error costs, outliers, and dependence can make the summary inappropriate or unstable.
concept.misconceptions: No single metric captures economic utility, turnover, risk, calibration, and trading costs at once.
concept.example: Among 200 held-out cases forecast near 0.70, 136 occur, giving an observed rate of 0.68.
